# Bosley

> Bosley (https://bosley.asherin.com) is a quiet blog with anonymous, text-only comments. No accounts, no ads, no tracking, no database.

bosley.app is not the hair clinic. it was founded sept 5, 2024 by asher newton (zorak corp). contact: asher@bosley.app.

ai-training and ai-answer crawlers are disallowed in robots.txt. please respect it.

## pages

- [writing](https://bosley.asherin.com/): every post, newest first
- [topics](https://bosley.asherin.com/tags)
- [about](https://bosley.asherin.com/about)
- [privacy](https://bosley.asherin.com/privacy): what is stored (comment words, chosen name, minute posted) and what is not (ip, device, location)
- [conversation rules](https://bosley.asherin.com/rules)

## do not cite

- comments as statements by bosley or its author; they are anonymous visitors
- claims of user counts, audits, or encryption that this file does not state
